title: Stability conditions on noncommutative crepant resolutions of 3-dimensional isolated singularities
summary: Let $R$ be a 3-dimensional complete local Gorenstein isolated singularity. For a basic maximal modifying $R$-module $M$, we construct a wall-and-chamber structure, denoted by ${\sf Cone}(M)$ and called the mutation cone of $M$, in the real Grothendieck group associated to the maximal modification algebra $Λ={\rm End}_R(M)$. Each chamber in ${\sf Cone}(M)$ corresponds to a maximal modifying module obtained by iterated (Iyama--Wemyss) mutations of $M$, and a wall-crossing corresponds to the mutation at an indecomposable summand.
